name: Eternal Glyphs (CR 9)
body:
Eternal Glyphs
CR 9

XP 6,400

Source: Pathfinder #10

Type magical Perception DC 33 Disable Device DC 33

EFFECTS

Trigger when read; Reset automatic

Effect suggestion effect (heightened to 8th level) to continue reading glyphs (Will DC 23 negates, new save may be attempted each day at a cumulative –2 penalty)
